name: manual_985360
claim: Failure-path test harnesses must terminate deterministically: report broken process barriers through the result queue, stop reader loops in finally when creator futures fail, and distinguish an expected not-running worker signal from unexpected runtime failure. Assert specific refusal codes and audited denial state.

decisions.notes: Closure PT481 2eb26264 and 57eb3412 prevent test hangs; Oramasys95 b23a678 prevents phantom-running expiry workers; malformed failure classes now produce audited envelope.invalid rather than uncaught TypeError.
